address.label: Address
address.helperText: Place of publication or event location

crossref.label: Cross reference
crossref.helperText: Citation key of a related entry

doi.label: Digital object identifier (DOI)
doi.helperText: The identifier only, not the full URL, e.g. 10.1000/xyz123

eprint.label: Eprint
eprint.helperText: The preprint archive identifier, e.g. math/0307200v3

howpublished.label: How published
howpublished.helperText: How the work was made available, e.g. Poster presentation or Self-published

titleaddon.label: Title addon
titleaddon.helperText: Any addition to the title not part of the original

addendum.label: Addendum
addendum.helperText: Any closing note added after the main reference details

pubstate.label: Publication state
pubstate.helperText: The publication status, e.g. In press or Submitted

introduction.label: Introduction
introduction.helperText: Author of the introduction. Separate multiple names with "and"

foreword.label: Foreword
foreword.helperText: Author of the foreword. Separate multiple names with "and"

afterword.label: Afterword
afterword.helperText: Author of the afterword. Separate multiple names with "and"

holder.label: Holder
holder.helperText: The copyright holder, typically used for patents

maintitle.label: Main title
maintitle.helperText: Main title of a multi-volume work

maintitleaddon.label: Main title addon
maintitleaddon.helperText: Any addition to the title not part of the original

booktitleaddon.label: Book title addon
booktitleaddon.helperText: Any addition to the title not part of the original

journaltitleaddon.label: Journal title addon
journaltitleaddon.helperText: Any addition to the title not part of the original

issuetitleaddon.label: Issue title addon
issuetitleaddon.helperText: Any addition to the title not part of the original

eventtitleaddon.label: Event title addon
eventtitleaddon.helperText: Any addition to the title not part of the original

isrn.label: ISRN
isrn.helperText: The report identifier, equivalent to ISBN for technical reports

eprintclass.label: Eprint class
eprintclass.helperText: The subject class for the preprint, e.g. cs.AI

urldate.label: URL date
urldate.helperText: The date you accessed the page

origlanguage.label: Original language
origlanguage.helperText: The original language if this is a translation
